spans.s: There are two injunctions--one takes the Ṣoḍaśin cup at the time of Atirātra sacrifice; and also one does not take that Ṣoḍaśin cut at the time of Atirātra sacrifice. As the two cannot be reconciled, option (Vikalpa) is permitted here. When one sense is accepted, the other one becomes exception (Paryudāsa).
